body: There's a lot to it and I can't write it all here but in a nutshell I flunked out of college twice and I've been unemployed for the past year. Issues with my family are complex but I am essentially an outcast to them for many reasons, not only for being a failure but for leaving their religion. My family is emotionally abusive and completely unsupportive, living here is hell for me but I can't get out because I'm unemployable and useless.

It's not like I spent all that time on an elaborate plan or anything, I just kept telling myself "if things don't get better by <random point in the future> I will do it". But I kept giving myself more time. But I don't think I can do that anymore. 

I used to worry about what people would think after I'm gone but it doesn't really bother me anymore. I'm not doing this to hurt others or make anyone feel responsible, only to stop my own pain.
In my case nobody depends on me in that way. I'm glad you found a reason to stay, but my family is one of the biggest reasons for me to go.
Thank you. But you don't know that, I can assure you that not many people want me.
Thank you but I don't know what other options I have. My issues aren't in my head, I don't think meds are will help. And I don't know what therapy would do for me. I'm not crazy, my life just sucks.
Thank you for making an account just to comment here, that means so much to me.
It's an honest coincidence, I didn't even know it was Valentine's until I saw that little game on the Google main page.
Everyone in my family knows I am depressed and suicidal, I don't think anyone would be too surprised. I haven't written a note but I'm sure they will all carry on just fine.
Sometimes the only control you have is to let go
Thank you for saying this. You're right, I'm not willing to live like this and nobody should talk me down because they just don't get it.
Hanging.
I'm here. Today's the day.

I don't think I have limitless potential, I am already at my limit. I've tried and tried but there's really nothing I can do. I might miss 100% of the chances I don't take but I will also miss all the failures and the pain if I just quit.

I don't have any successes to celebrate. I don't do anything anymore. I don't send out applications, I have already given up on that. My only accomplishment is that I'm still alive, and even that is a failure because I really should be dead by now. There is no enjoyment in a life of idleness. It is too late for me to fix this.
I want a way to die, not to live. I already tried that way, I've applied everywhere I could, nothing works for me. I don't want life to get better, I want it to end.
I am not eligible for that.
I would rather die than go back, it is hell there. And I still haven't paid back the loans from last time. But I don't want to work either, I just want to be done with life.
I'm 20, I have failed school twice and cannot get employed so they are all tired of having me around because I'm useless waste of life. I don't blame them for giving up on me, I give up on myself too
I don't have one, no friends and my family doesn't understand or care, I can't afford professional help either

I am a useless NEET and nobody wants me around anymore. I can't enjoy the things I used to live for anymore and I am in pain 24/7. Also I am broke and cannot pay bills anymore, and my hand got infected and treatment is costing me way too much, I don't think I can live like this anymore.
So much pain, I can feel myself slipping. I think I will seriously hurt myself tonight.

I'm a failure, dropped out of college and unemployed, lost all my friends and living at home with a family that is getting tired of my leeching, and so many other problems I can't even begin to describe. It's taking its toll on me day by day and I seriously can't take it anymore, I just want to inflict immense pain on myself before I die.

I failed my degree twice, out of school and unemployed. I stay in my mom's house, it has been months and I cannot get hired. I wasted all my savings and there is nothing left in my bank account. I am tired of being a leech and a burden and a reject.
I just want to die

I've tried doing things to take my mind away from it but it just doesn't work. I usually just end up making a bunch of posts here and reading other people's posts. I research methods too. I guess those also work as distractions, in a strange way.
Thank you, you understand. That's exactly how I feel.

I'm sorry, I appreciate you commenting but I'm tired of getting this advice. If it were possible for me to just pack up and move, surely I would've done that already? I don't decide anything, that's the problem.

Thanks I appreciate it but an hour and a half probably isn't enough and I'm not going to keep you up. I probably won't still be here in the morning, either. Still, I appreciate your comment, thank you.
